title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
summary: Group the values of a binary tree by level: top level first, left to right within each level.

tests.explain: Row by row: [1], then [2, 3], then 4 (under 2) followed by 5 and 6 (under 3), then 7 (under 4).
No nodes, so no levels: return an empty array.

hints: You need the values grouped by depth, top to bottom, and left to right inside each group.
A queue already hands you the nodes in exactly that order. The only question is where one level ends and the next begins.
At the start of each level, record size = the number of nodes waiting. Dequeue exactly size nodes into one array, enqueuing their children as you go.

complexity.time: O(n): every node is enqueued and dequeued once
complexity.space: O(w) for the queue (plus O(n) for the output)
